description.en: Starts setting up a new skill scene: it empties the skill scene settings (the table the CMND_SETUP_SKL_SQ_* commands and CMND_RUN_SKILL_SCRIPT fill) and clears system flag 6 (the flag RunTactics calls IFLAG_END_AUTO_FADEIN_OFF). The events call it before each skill scene.

examples.case: Two skill scenes in a row (real usage, from ev42011800.nut)
